source_path: Floom original. Written on 2026-10-04 and first run on Federico De Ponte's own LinkedIn analytics export for the 365 days ending 2026-10-04.
note: The method is Federico De Ponte's: read the year's totals, growth and concentration first, then compare what reached people with what got reactions, and check timing last. The script was written by Claude Opus 5.5 in Claude Code and reads the AggregateAnalytics .xlsx file LinkedIn offers under creator analytics. It runs on the user's computer, makes no network call and needs no account or key. The bundle contains no analytics data, no post text and no private paths. It is not derived from an upstream skill and is not affiliated with or endorsed by LinkedIn.
